{{Quote|Top-of-the-line prototype capital ships, ion cannons, cluster missiles and a few experimental goodies.|[[Darmas Pollaran]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Project Nebula''' was a former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] operation of weapons development abandoned when the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] took the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where it was being developed and funded by [[General]] [[Var Suthra]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]]. The Sith Empire then took over the project intending on using the prototype weaponry against the Republic. In [[3642 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]], was assigned to disrupt Project Nebula before the Empire could use it to harm the Republic.
